quality.title: Releases & quality
quality.lead: Release channels, install proofs, eval results and what a successful run costs — built from docs/evidence on every deploy.
quality.chartTitle: Cost per successful run, by eval case
quality.chartNote: Same {n} cases on both versions; main model {model}, subagents on their own models. Agent cost only, judge excluded. Every run counts toward the cost, failed ones included.
quality.sources: Sources: docs/evidence/*.json (claude plugin eval --json, claude plugin list --json), the stable branch's marketplace.json, and agent frontmatter at each release tag. Refresh: run the evals, then node scripts/build-quality.mjs.
quality.passNote: Wilson score interval over all pooled runs. Overlapping intervals mean the difference is not proven yet; more runs narrow them.
quality.historyTitle: Cost per successful run over time
quality.historyNote: One point per eval session, in run order, measured on the cases every session ran. Hover for the source file.
quality.pipelineLead: The whole spec → plan → implement → verify pipeline on a fixture project (scripts/pipeline), measured with workflow-retro. A run succeeds when plan-verifier says COMPLETE.
quality.noPipeline: No pipeline benchmark yet: run scripts/pipeline/run.sh <tree>.
